readings.repeat: intron 9 (legacy IVS8) TG and poly-T tract
readings.reading: 5T: 2 copys with the 5T poly-T tract, TG12 on the 5T copies. 5T lowers the splicing of exon 10 and is a variable-penetrance allele: with TG12 or TG13 on the same copy it more often causes CBAVD or another CFTR-related disorder when the other copy carries a CF-causing variant. R117H was not read (no step 42 traits row for rs78655421 was called), so whether it sits on the 5T copy is not known.
*28/TA9 (TA7/TA9, 8/10 TA units as ExpansionHunter counts them): a TA length outside TA5 to TA8 is not a named allele here, so its function is not read and it is not compared with PharmCAT (step 7).

not tested by any step. CPIC's 2023 SSRI guideline (Bousman et al. 2023, PMID 37032427) found that the data on SLC6A4 do not support its use in antidepressant prescribing, so a result would carry no recommendation.
